source_visual_observations: Circle with consecutive A,B,C,D; chordsAB,BC,CD,DB,AC crossingatE; CEB110°; arcsAB=BC=CD inquestion.
audit.independent_solution: Let each equal minor arcAB,BC,CD have measuret. The remaining arcAD is360−3t. Intersecting chords give CEB=(arcCB+arcAD)/2=(360−2t)/2=110°, so t=70°. Inscribed BDC=t/2=35°, choice A.
